name: Hermit
source:
Moyshe wanders into the wilderness, struggling against hunger, grief, and the haunting echoes of his past. Guided by his parents’ teachings, he learns to take life only with reverence, fighting to remain compassionate even as survival forces him into violence.

[From [url=https://erik-lupical.itch.io/hermit]Itch.io[/url]]
